modelOverview: The Aquanaut 5167A is Patek Philippe's steel sports-luxury companion to the Nautilus, introduced in 2007 as the larger-cased, slimmer second generation of the original 1997 Aquanaut (ref. 5060A). Its rounded octagonal case, embossed checkerboard-pattern dial and durable Tropical composite rubber strap give it a distinctly casual, youthful character within the Patek catalogue. Today it is one of the most requested steel sports references from the manufacture, running the self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C.

5167A-001.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 26-330 S C · 35–45h power reserve
5167A-001.materials: Stainless steel case on a black composite (Tropical rubber) strap with steel fold-over clasp
5167A-001.bezel: Steel gently-rounded octagonal bezel with contrasting polished and satin-brushed finishes, no visible screws
5167A-001.dial: Sunburst charcoal-grey/black dial with black-gradient rim, embossed Aquanaut checkerboard pattern, white-gold applied numerals and baton hands with luminescent coating
5167A-001.description: The 5167A-001 is the standard-bearer of the modern steel Aquanaut line, prized by collectors for its embossed black dial, screw-down crown and comfortable Tropical rubber strap. It runs the self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C with date and sweep seconds beneath a sapphire caseback. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Black Tropical: 5167A-001 in stainless steel on its black Tropical composite strap with the standard embossed black/charcoal sunburst dial, the benchmark configuration for the modern steel Aquanaut.

5167A-025.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 324 S C · 35–45h power reserve
5167A-025.materials: Stainless steel case on a khaki green composite (Tropical rubber) strap with steel fold-over clasp
5167A-025.bezel: Steel gently-rounded octagonal bezel with contrasting polished and satin-brushed finishes, no visible screws
5167A-025.dial: Embossed khaki green checkerboard-pattern dial with gilt/gold-tone applied numerals and luminescent coating, matching khaki green strap
5167A-025.year: 2011 (the only documented steel khaki-green Aquanaut is the 5167A-010, an extremely limited 'special clients' production believed to be fewer than 10 pieces; the reference '5167A-025' could not be independently confirmed in any manufacturer or reference database)
5167A-025.description: The khaki green dial Aquanaut is one of the most sought-after colourways in the steel 5167A family, sharing the same 40mm case and embossed checkerboard dial texture as the standard black-dial model. Unlike the current-production 5167A-001, the confirmed green-dial reference (5167A-010) was an extremely limited, special-clients-only run from 2011 fitted with the earlier self-winding Calibre 324 S C, making it dramatically harder to source than the black-strap standard model. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Khaki Green: 5167A-025 in stainless steel on a khaki green Tropical composite strap with the matching embossed khaki green checkerboard dial, a scarcer colourway alternative to the standard black 5167A-001.
